description: A PROACTIVE eligibility match raised for a CONSENTING member — 'you may be eligible for procedure/benefit X' (the LINE-公式アカウント notify role; ADR-2605312030 §3, `toritsugi_eligibility_match`). CONSTITUTIONAL: derived ONLY from the member's OWN life-event/profile data with consent (G3); never a third party; data-minimised (G12); cites the procedure it points to and its legalBasis (G8 — no fabricated entitlement). This record holds match METADATA + a pointer, never plaintext member PII (member detail lands only in com.etzhayyim.encrypted.* per G6).

memberDid.description: The consenting member's DID (G3 identity binding)

procedureRef.description: AT-URI / rkey of the toritsugi.procedure this match points to

rationale.description: Why the member may be eligible (cites the life-event/criterion; no fabricated entitlement, G8). Not a legal determination (G5).

confidence.description: Soft signal only — NOT an adjudication of eligibility (G5)

consentRef.description: Reference to the member's recorded consent to be matched (G3)

encryptedDetailRef.description: Pointer to the com.etzhayyim.encrypted.* envelope holding any member PII used (G6); never inline PII
